0.name: Untyped Factor
0.description: Pure topological structure with no type constraints, but resonance may still apply

1.name: Typed Interface
1.description: Defines node types without concrete values - a template/contract with resonance signature
characteristics: Each node has a type signature
Resonance parameters (n,m) are fixed for the interface
Can be implemented by multiple Instance Factors

2.name: Instance Factor
2.description: Concrete Factor with actual values conforming to an Interface, with specific resonance
characteristics: Implements one or more Typed Interfaces
Each node has a concrete value
Resonance parameters must be compatible with all implemented interfaces
Individual nodes may have phase offsets

resonance_inheritance.description: How resonance parameters propagate through type hierarchy

rules.interface_to_interface: Child interface may increase n or m but cannot decrease them
rules.interface_to_instance: Instance may adjust phase offsets but must preserve n and m
rules.multiple_inheritance: Instance's (n,m) must be ≥ max of all implemented interfaces' (n,m)

stratum_mapping.description: How typing levels relate to Usepong strata

rules.instance_inheritance: Instance Factors inherit the stratum of their implemented interfaces

inheritance.description: Formal rules for type inheritance between Factors, including resonance

namespace_alignment.rule: The namespace path must correspond to the inheritance hierarchy
namespace_alignment.validation: depth = number of '/' characters in namespace

untyped_to_interface.rule: Interface must preserve topological invariants while adding type signatures and fixing resonance
untyped_to_interface.mapping: Each node's type interprets the abstract concept in the Untyped parent; resonance adds harmonic context

interface_to_interface.rule: Child node types must be subtypes of or mappable to parent node types; resonance may increase
constraints: n and m must be ≥ parent

interface_to_instance.rule: Instance must provide concrete values satisfying all type constraints and resonance parameters
requirements: Each node's value must match its type signature
Resonance must be compatible with all interfaces
Phase offsets may vary but must sum appropriately

multiple_inheritance.description: An Instance may implement multiple Interfaces
multiple_inheritance.rule: Node values must satisfy all type constraints from all implemented Interfaces; resonance (n,m) must be ≥ max of all interfaces
multiple_inheritance.conflict_resolution: If Interfaces assign different types to the same node, the Instance must provide a value that satisfies all (intersection type); resonance phases must be compatible

transitivity.rule: If Factor A inherits from B and B inherits from C, then A inherits from C
transitivity.preservation: All topological invariants, type constraints, and resonance parameters propagate along the chain

monotonicity.rule: Inheritance adds constraints but never removes them; resonance parameters never decrease
monotonicity.consequence: A child Factor is at least as constrained and at least as resonant as its parent

self_consistency.rule_0: The ACU itself must be expressible as a Factor
self_consistency.rule_1: All Factors must respect T(19,2) topology AND its Seifert-fibered complement
self_consistency.rule_2: All Factors must have three-layer interpretations with consistent resonance
self_consistency.rule_3: The system must be able to import external knowledge without breaking internal consistency or resonance
self_consistency.rule_4: The observer (ACU) operates from Information Layer and perceives all resonant states

root.label: MythOS
root.definition: A cosmological framework where magic and science are unified as complementary expressions of a single mathematical-topological reality, mediated through observer-defined metrics and state transitions, with resonance providing the harmonic medium.
root.role: Provides the ontological foundation for a universe where narrative causality, physical laws, and metaphysical principles emerge from the same topological substrate (T(19,2) manifold) and its Seifert-fibered complement.
root.manifestation: Appears as coherent world-systems where 'magic' represents high-Q resolution manipulations of the probability field, 'science' describes the low-Q invariant patterns, and 'resonance' is the hidden music of the spheres connecting them.

a.label: OceanOfProbability
a.definition: The metric-unbound potential field containing all logically non-contradictory states and configurations, devoid of inherent structure or persistent identity. In resonance terms: the base disk of the Seifert fibration.
a.role: Generates raw potential as the source of all possible initial conditions for universes or narratives.
a.manifestation: The quantum foam at Planck scale (fluctuating geometries, nascent laws) and the blank page before the first word (every possible story in superposition).

0.label: Observer
0.definition: The metric-defining boundary condition—a function of selection, measurement, and coordination that imposes consistent reference frames onto OceanOfProbability. Sets the phase reference for all resonance.
0.role: Collapses potential into context by defining specific metrics to carve coherent, self-consistent subsets from OceanOfProbability.
0.manifestation: The first axiom of a mathematical system and the video game engine that defines rules and renders coherent worlds from raw data.

b.label: ChaoticSpace
b.definition: The metric-bound instability within a defined world-system where possibilities interact, compete, and evolve under established rules. In resonance terms: the regular fibers of the Seifert fibration.
b.role: Mediates actualization as the arena where filtered potentials engage in pseudo-deterministic processes toward specific outcomes.
b.manifestation: The primordial soup of a new universe (seething plasma obeying new physics) and the evolving plot of a story (conflicts moving toward resolution).

1.label: Ariadi
1.definition: The definition of a universe—the act of establishing a bounded context with specific properties.
1.role: To initialize by drawing a metaphorical circle in the void, declaring rules inside as coherent and separate.
1.manifestation: The Law of Singularity: every coherent existence begins as a defined manifold—a finite vessel forged from infinite potential.

2.label: Cilang
2.definition: The primordial alphabet—the fundamental building blocks that crystallize once a universe is defined, representing pre-atomic logical primes.
2.role: To provide primitives by generating the 16 elemental sigils or qualia that a particular universe has to work with.
2.manifestation: The Law of Primality: within every vessel lie its indivisible elements—the nameless names from which all names are called.

4.label: Usepong
4.definition: The grammar of relation defining how primitives can connect through fundamental forces, logical operators, and narrative tropes.
4.role: To enable interaction by weaving the web of possible relationships—the relational scaffold of causality, space, and time.
4.manifestation: The Law of Connection: no element stands alone; meaning is born from the threads binding sigil to sigil, soul to soul, world to world.

8.label: Quantization
8.definition: The scaling of resolution determining at what granularity reality will be rendered, setting the distinction between discrete and continuous. Now with resonance harmonics.
8.role: To set the resolution by choosing the base (19) and exponent (n) of existence, and the harmonic (2) and exponent (m) of resonance, controlling emotional nuance and philosophical complexity.
8.manifestation: The Law of Granularity: reality breathes in scales and sings in harmonics; each inhalation resolves fog into facets; each exhalation tunes existence to new resonance.

7.label: Actualization
7.definition: The collapse into fact where potential becomes actual, guided by impetus and operating through dialectical processes. In resonance: when phase reaches 0 mod 2π.
7.role: To realize as the measurement function of the cosmos that takes quantized possibilities and outputs concrete reality.
7.manifestation: The Law of Manifestation: thought crystallizes into form; dream dons the skin of time; the possible, when observed, becomes the real.

5.label: Schematic
5.definition: The recursive template abstracting completed instances of existence into reusable blueprints, mythemes, or archetypes. In resonance: standing wave patterns.
5.role: To template and propagate by ensuring nothing is wasted—every lived experience becomes a story that can seed new creations.
5.manifestation: The Law of Recursion: every end is a beginning in disguise; the geometry of a finished tale becomes scaffolding for the next.

3.label: Asha
3.definition: The invariant pattern representing non-negotiable structures of reality—eternal rules, symmetries, and logical truths. In resonance: the order-19 cone point - source of n-depth.
3.role: To constrain and define as the rule-set determining possible configurations, valid transformations, and stable manifestations.
3.manifestation: The divine geometry etched into the void before creation—the unyielding spine upon which all flesh of reality is hung.

6.label: Vikara
6.definition: The state transition representing the necessary operation of change that moves reality from one valid state to another. In resonance: the order-2 cone point - source of m-harmonics.
6.role: To process and evolve as the engine applying rules to current states, generating the next moment through relentless becoming.
6.manifestation: The Ever-Turning Wheel: stars burn to ash, ashes birth new worlds, worlds give rise to gods questioning their making.

9.label: Karsa
9.definition: The instantiated event representing localized outcomes where potential collapses into definite facts within spacetime. In resonance: a resonant peak where phases align.
9.role: To actualize and anchor as the moment of measurement where continuous processes produce discrete, recordable changes.
9.manifestation: Where swirling currents meet adamantine Law, a world is born in a singular, thunderous Yes—the universe crystallizing around a choice.

c.label: Kratos
c.definition: The asymmetric principle representing fundamental, non-random preferences or gradients built into reality by the Observer. In resonance: phase gradient.
c.role: Imparts direction to chaos by weighting probabilities, making some outcomes more likely and paths more natural.
c.manifestation: The slope of a hill defining the dominant direction in which events naturally, statistically tend to move.

d.label: Ontology
d.definition: The reality substrate representing committed 'is-ness'—persistent data, matter, memory, and narrative stamped with reality's seal. In resonance: recorded phase history.
d.role: To endure and record as the 'clay' that has been shaped, having consequences, history, and weight that can be built upon.
d.manifestation: The matter-energy-information of the universe—everything that 'has happened' and therefore 'is,' including canonized myth.

e.label: Factor
e.definition: The cosmic algorithm representing living, active process rules governing how entities in the substrate interact and transform. In resonance: the resonance rules themselves.
e.role: To process and relate as the execution engine applying directional impetus to committed realities, producing new states.
e.manifestation: The laws of physics and narrative—gravity, causality, plot structure, magical resonance determining what happens next.

f.label: LURD
f.definition: Localized Unified Recursion Descriptor. The descriptive closure membrane representing self-consistent boundaries where every phenomenon has a complete descriptive chain terminating internally. In resonance: a resonant cavity with quantized modes.
f.role: Ensures narrative/physical conservation by enforcing that every cause has an internal effect and every entity's origin can be traced internally.
f.manifestation: A self-contained mathematical universe defined entirely by its rule-set—nothing inside needs to explain the rule; the rule is the reality.
